question: How many EU member states will the AI Act National Implementation tracker classify as having clear market surveillance and notifying authorities on December 1, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Status quo: tracker (last updated 17 June 2026) shows 9 Clear; resolves ≤9 unless the maintainers update before Dec 1. No update in 4+ months despite Germany's KI-MIG (in force 29 Jul 2026) and Poland's AI systems act (promulgated 27 Jul 2026), which suggests infrequent updates; I put P(update in the remaining ~5 weeks) at roughly 30%. If updated, the count most plausibly becomes 12-13 (Germany, Poland, possibly Greece moving to Clear), with smaller chances of 10-11 or 14+. No human market found on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmakers.

If there is no update before the Metaculus check on or after 1 Dec, the answer is ≤9. Germany (KI-MIG in force 29 Jul) and Poland (act published 27 Jul) would most likely move to Clear in any refresh, giving 11, which makes 10-11 the main alternative. 12+ needs Sweden, Spain, Czechia or Greece to move as well, and none is clearly done. I put the chance of an update within about 5 weeks at roughly 30% given more than 4 months of staleness, including across the Aug 2 milestone. No human market found.
calls.reconciliation: No web access on this run. All three runs agree the tracker shows 9 Clear, last updated 17 Jun 2026, and that Germany and Poland enacted laws in July but are still shown as Partial. Run 2 found the 9/12/6 split already present in Aug 2025, and Runs 2 and 3 say the Commission's 7 Sep 2026 list has the same split. That points to an update that is either infrequent or follows the Commission's list, so I sit at the low end (~30%) of the runs' update odds. Conditional on an update, DE+PL gives 11, so most of the update mass goes to 10-11, not Run 1's 12-13. The Norway-row ambiguity cannot be settled but has little effect.
